event_name: Document 55 Date 27 September 2020 Time 18:58 2020 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 September 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received information from Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of the FIA International Sporting Code Article 12.1.1 (i), failure to follow the instructions contained in the Event Notes (v3) item 19.1, practice start location at 13:35 and Article 36.1 FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards received information from the team that the driver of car 44 had received a team instruction to perform the practice start in the incorrect place. This was confirmed by the Stewards having listened to the audio between the Team and the Driver. Based on this information the Stewards replace document 47 with this decision and therefore remove the penalty points imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Replacement For Document 47 Offence Car 44 2Nd Practice Start
